Melissa Crenshaw Writes:

Hi Everyone: I have just this week been asked to present an update on 

Holography activity in Canada at the upcoming 7th Symposium on Display Holography. Sadly, I have lost touch with some of my old holo pals from back east. I would like to present a brief update and one or two Jpg. images of each persons recent (hey, past 5 years isfine) holo related activity. If there are any of you out there, please get in touch with me and please pass this along.. Thanks! My email address for this is [HolographicDesign@Yahoo.com](mailto:HolographicDesign@Yahoo.com)

Melissa Crenshaw
